title: Senior Project Officer II – NMIS, DMLP & DOTS
rawSnippet: Senior Project Officer II – NMIS, DMLP & DOTS Full Time Ethiopian Agricultural Transformation Agency (ATA) Addis Ababa new Expires: October 4, 2026
fullDescription:
About the Job

• Employment:                One year with the possibility of extension

• Duty Station:            Addis Ababa, Secondment to MOTRI with travel to regional project sites as required.

• Required Number:        Two

• Application Deadline:   October 3, 2026

BACKGROUND

The Ethiopian Agricultural Transformation Institute (ATI), formerly known as the Agricultural Transformation Agency (ATA), is a strategy and delivery-oriented government institute created to help accelerate the growth and transformation of Ethiopia’s agriculture sector, which is a key contributor to the country’s GDP, exports, Systems and capacities of the workforces. The ATI’s focuses on improving the livelihoods of smallholder farmers, pastoralists, internally displaced people (IDPs), recovering people affected by conflict and other across the country for improved income, inclusiveness, resilience, and sustainability.

The ATI works to transform the agriculture and rural development in Ethiopia by conducting analytical studies in the policy and programmatic areas, piloting innovative agricultural technologies and systems, creating jobs to youth and women along the value chain providing technical implementation support, linking actors along the value-chains and attracting foreign direct investment who can work with cluster farmers, implementing problem based, inclusive and sustainable innovative projects and programs and building capacities of diverse players along the transformation continuum. The Institute joins forces with various stakeholders, like MoA and other affiliate Institutions of the Ministry, policymakers, researchers, farmers, and development partners, to support the implementation of agricultural development programs and initiatives. In addition, the ATI collaborates with national and international partners to facilitate knowledge exchange, learning opportunities and resources mobilization. The Institute plays a crucial role primarily in supporting agricultural policy and strategies development to drive transformation of agriculture and rural development; facilitate knowledge exchange, generating and disseminating information to support evidence-based policy formulation and decision-making and pilot innovative projects to be scaled nationwide.

OUR CULTURE

ATI brings together highly competent specialists to address some of the toughest challenges in agriculture and rural development and make transformation a practical reality. We work with clear insight and foresight analysis, measurable goals, making use of the unique strengths of our staff. We have an exceptional team of highly competent employees with a proven track record of success in managing complex activities and achieving transformational results. Our culture is one where talented, dedicated, and adaptable individuals are committed to doing their best and exhibit great teamwork to achieve excellent results.

At ATI, we provide an exceptional platform for people who want to achieve their highest potential and make a meaningful contribution to agricultural and rural transformation leading to structural changes of the sector. We expand our thinking, strengthen our capabilities, and redefine our roles to cover new settings to the extent possible fitting to national, continental and global dynamics. We offer rewarding work in a young, fast-paced growing organization with passionate, committed, motivated colleagues and excellent career development and training. We recognize our most valuable assets are our staff and are committed to providing our employees with the tools, training, and mentorships necessary to achieve their career goals.

The ATI is committed to fostering a safe, respectful, inclusive, and equitable environment for its employees, farmers, partners, and all stakeholders. We maintain zero tolerance for any form of abuse, exploitation, harassment, discrimination, bullying, retaliation, or other harmful conduct. The Institute is dedicated to promoting equal opportunity, diversity, and inclusion by ensuring fair and respectful treatment regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnicity, religion, or other protected characteristics. We expect all employees, consultants, and partners to uphold ATI’s Safeguarding Policy, Code of Conduct, and related ethical standards in all interactions with colleagues, farmers, communities, and stakeholders. Successful candidates will be required to demonstrate commitment to these principles and to contribute to a workplace and service environment that protects the dignity, rights, safety, and well-being of all individuals.

There are many reasons to join us, but if you are seeking a dynamic and meaningful career whin a community of talented professionals with diverse expertise-collaborating to create real impact-ATI is the right place for you.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Project Officers will support the implementation, operational management, institutionalization, and expansion of the National Market Information System (NMIS), Digital Output Tracking System (DOTS), and Digital Market Linkage Platform (DMLP). Although employed by ATI, the officers will be seconded to the Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration (MOTRI) to provide day-to-day technical and operational support as part of ATI’s long-term sustainability and institutional transition strategy.

The role involves project coordination, stakeholder engagement, technical supervision, data migration, system integration support, capacity building, monitoring and reporting, and facilitation of collaboration among public and private sector stakeholders. The officers will also support the institutionalization of the systems by strengthening governance structures, operational processes, and coordination mechanisms necessary for sustainable system ownership and operation by MOTRI.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Outcome 1: NMIS, DOTS, and DMLP Implementation & Operational Support (30%)

• Support the implementation, rollout, and operational management of the National Market Information System (NMIS), Digital Output Tracking System (DOTS), and Digital Market Linkage Platform (DMLP), while enhancing the implementation capacity of newly recruited regular NMIS, DOTS, and DMLP teams within the Ministry.

• Coordinate day-to-day technical and operational activities in collaboration with ATI, MOTRI, technology providers, and other stakeholders,

• Monitor system functionality, identify operational bottlenecks, and facilitate timely resolution of technical and implementation issues.

• Support system enhancement, integration, testing, and deployment activities.

Outcome 2: Stakeholder Coordination & Institutionalization Support (25%)

• Strengthen collaboration and coordination among federal and regional government institutions, private sector actors, development partners, and other stakeholders.

• Support the institutionalization and long-term sustainability of NMIS, DOTS, and DMLP within MOTRI through joint planning, coordination, and operational alignment.

• Facilitate the establishment and operationalization of governance and coordination mechanisms, including technical working groups and steering committees.

• Support the development and implementation of partnership agreements, implementation plans, and operational guidelines.

Outcome 3: Data Management, Monitoring & Reporting (20%)

• Support market data collection, validation, analysis, and dissemination activities to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability.

• Monitor implementation progress, risks, and system performance indicators using advanced tracking tools like Jira and Excel dashboards and recommend corrective actions where necessary.

• Prepare regular technical, operational, and performance reports for ATI, MOTRI, and development partners.

• Document implementation lessons, best practices, and operational experiences for knowledge management and continuous improvement.

Outcome 4: Capacity Building & Technical Support (15%)

• Coordinate and support training programs for enumerators, focal persons, system users, and other stakeholders.

• Provide technical guidance and user support to ensure effective utilization of the systems.

• Support awareness creation and user mobilization activities to enhance system adoption and engagement.

• Assist in troubleshooting operational and technical challenges affecting system users and field operations.

Outcome 5: Strategic & Cross-Functional Support (10%)

• Support ATI and MOTRI in implementing strategic digital agriculture initiatives related to market systems and digital transformation.

• Contribute to planning, review, and coordination meetings related to NMIS, DOTS, and DMLP activities.

• Perform other related duties assigned by ATI and MOTRI management in support of project objectives and institutional priorities.
requirements:
REQUIRED 

, COMPETENCIES, AND EXPERIENCE

• Education: At least a master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Project Management, Data Science or data analysis  or other related fields.

• Experience: Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience in digital agriculture, market information systems, digital platforms, or ICT-enabled development initiatives, of which at least 2 years in project coordination or leadership roles.

• Demonstrated experience in the design, implementation, coordination, or management of digital systems or platforms.

• Proven experience working with government institutions, development partners, private sector actors, and technology providers on large-scale digital transformation or development projects.

• Knowledge in PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, and MSP Practitioner.

• Solid knowledge and hands-on experience in Ethiopian market dynamics and marketing practices.

• Familiarity with blockchain-enabled tracking systems, AI-powered analytics, or digital traceability technologies is desirable.

• Experience in market information systems, digital marketplaces, supply chain tracking and traceability systems, or data analytics platforms is highly desirable.

• Experience in stakeholder coordination, institutionalization, and governance support for digital systems is an advantage.

• Proven knowledge and practical experience in project coordination, stakeholder management, implementation planning, and institutionalization of digital systems.

• Expert-level proficiency in reporting tools, including Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, and data visualization tools such as Power BI and Excel dashboards.

• Working knowledge of database structures and integration points with other systems – including understanding how user data is stored and shared across platforms.

• Experience in capacity building, technical support, and user engagement activities is desirable.

Skills

• Strong analytical, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

• Good understanding of digital platforms, market information systems, and ICT-enabled service delivery.

• Ability to synthesize technical and operational issues into practical recommendations.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Proficiency in project monitoring, reporting, and data analysis tools.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities effectively.

Core Competencies

• Strategic thinking and implementation planning

• Stakeholder coordination and partnership building

• Analytical and problem-solving skills

• Adaptability and innovation orientation

• Results-oriented with strong attention to detail

• Teamwork and collaboration

• Strong accountability and professional integrity





Communication & Negotiation

How To Apply

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

We invite all candidates meeting the required 

 to submit (i) a cover letter and (ii) a CV (maximum 5 pages) to https://apply.ati.gov.et. It is mandatory to mention the position title in both the subject line of your cover letter and the Outlook email subject line. Please DO NOT submit scans of certificates with your application.

Women are highly encouraged to apply

NB. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Project Officer (SPO) II will provide technical support to Livestock Commodities Commercialization (LCC) project with focus on poultry and apiculture value chain development and agri-business initiatives in Benishangul Gumuz region. S/he will actively involve in the planning, coordination and implementation of livestock commodities commercialization project with focus on poultry and apiculture production, aggregation and processing (value addition), input-output marketing, input and service supply, business development, innovative market oriented extension approaches such as Livestock Farmers Filed School (LFFS), digital livestock extension. The Officer will coach and mentor value chain actors, monitor and evaluate the progress and achievements of prioritized interventions, and provide business advisory services. The Officer will ensure proper implementation of targeted livestock commodities commercialization (LCC) initiatives or interventions according to the plan and timely submission of high-quality report to regional ACC and HQ -Livestock Commodities Commercialization program. The Senior Project Officer II will map relevant stakeholders, identify areas of synergy and work together to develop the sector in the region and beyond.

The Livestock Commercialization Program of the ATI focuses on developing the huge potential of the Ethiopian livestock sector by leveraging the clustering approach of the ACC program which has realized a significant impact on improving production, productivity, and market linkages for prioritized crops. The Livestock Commercialization Program aims to address the significant and worsening undersupply of animal-sourced foods and to achieve improvements in farmers and pastoralists incomes, nutrition security, import substitution and forex availability through market-driven value-chain development approach while ensuring environmental sustainability. To achieve these strategic objectives, the program prioritized poultry (egg and meat) and apiculture (honey and other hive products) for immediate interventions in Benishangul Gumuz region.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Outcome 1: Technical Leadership and project management (60%)

• Provide high level technical/expertise support to the poultry and apiculture value chain activities in the region.

• Ensure effective technical and financial planning (annual, quarter, monthly) for poultry and apiculture commercialization activities of the region.

• Support project management in accordance with project documents, work plans and budgets and ensure that the work is delivered in consistent with the project implementation document.

• Coordinate and manage implementation of poultry and apiculture commercialization activities within the context of livestock commercialization program.

• Ensure all prioritized interventions of the poultry and apiculture project are successfully implemented following the respective commodities commercialization clustering approach and provide support to achieve the objective of the project.

• Closely support and work with other ATI project teams on livestock value chain development activities in the region.

• Identify and analyse critical technical issues related to the design and implementation of the project, and recommend solutions.

• Provide capacity development and advisory services to actors and project beneficiaries at different levels in the region.

• Provide technical leadership on the implementation of innovative market-oriented livestock extension approaches such as livestock farmers filed school (LFFS) in the region.

• Provide technical leadership in organizing poultry and apiculture production villages into marketing group and their transformation into more commercialized enterprises.

• Provide high-quality technical support to poultry (meat and egg) and apiculture value chain development through practical demonstrations, introduction of good production practices and technologies, and experience sharing.

• Monitor the progress and evaluate performance of the livestock commodities commercialization project and ensure delivery of high-quality report timely.

• Facilitate regional poultry and apiculture value chain alliance platforms.

• Ensure Cross Cutting Issues (Gender, CSA, and Nutrition) properly mainstreamed in the project interventions.

• Ensure effective communication among value chain actors.

• Undertake any other duties as assigned by the supervisors.

Outcome 2: Ensure effective teamwork and coordination (15%)

• Effectively manage programmatic as well operational component of the program

• Represent livestock commercialization project in various internal and external forums in the region.

• Develop Terms of References (ToR’s), organize logistics and facilitate workshops, trainings, field days and other events on prioritized activities.

• Ensure effective collaboration and teamwork with other ATI project teams in the region.

Outcome 3: Stakeholder engagement (10%)

• · Map poultry and apiculture value chain actors including the private sector and create linkage for effective and efficiency value chain development.

• · Facilitate stakeholder forums, business, and market linkages, and create linkage with sectoral associations.

• · Proactively engage with internal and external partners to identify major bottlenecks and recommend solutions for joint implementation.

• · Liaise with project team lead and Director of the program at HQ for effective and efficient implementation of the project.

• Ensure smooth working relationship with project beneficiaries, the private sectors and other stakeholders.

Outcome 4: Ensure effective communication and Representation (15%)

• Provide effective, timely and regular reporting to the program team lead and director and regional ACC directors on programmatic and operational issues.

• Ensure effective regular communication and reporting with internal and external partners.

• · Project Management Cycle – Experience with project design, performance management, learning systems and monitoring & evaluation.
